title: How Much Foundation
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 05
How Much Foundation

Most people use more foundation than they need.

About half a pump is enough for the whole face.
Apply it mainly to the centre of the face, then blend it outward, thinly.

When foundation covers every part of the face, the face looks flat.
When it stays at the centre, the edges keep their natural shadow.
That shadow does the work of contouring for you.

Less product, placed well.
The skin still looks like skin.
